title: Special Order for Earl Gill Trucking LLC, ex parte. — Earl Gill Trucking LLC, ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8540. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 8540 hereby is, cancelled.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                           SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 69-2026

                               EARL GILL TRUCKING LLC
                                      EX PARTE

                       In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8540
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC No. 8540 per a notarized affidavit
received on October 22, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC No. 8540 held by Earl Gill
Trucking LLC is hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees and fines owed
the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.

                                  (Decided October 26, 2026)




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
October 27, 2026



                                                 DISTRICT I
                                                 CHAIRMAN ERIC F. SKRMETTA
